requirement_text.REQ-393: Generic, tenant-agnostic entity-list browse screen with filter builder, sort control, and page-size control wired to POST /entities/query. WHAT EXISTS TODAY: EntityCrudPage.tsx (REQ-343) is BilimBaga-only, uses compile-time EXCLUDE_DELETED_FILTERS, client-side sort only, hardcoded PAGE_SIZE=25. WHAT IS NEEDED: Generic screen that (1) renders filter builder (field/operator/value, driven by EntityDefinition queried:true fields); (2) renders sort control (field+direction) sent as sort array to server; (3) renders page-size control surfacing :page_size_too_large 400 as readable message; (4) surfaces :field_not_allowed 422 as readable message; (5) writes real Playwright spec at web/tests/e2e/pipelines/entity-list-query.pipeline.e2e.spec.ts. OUT OF SCOPE: Vortex provisioning, REQ-394 authorization, BilimBaga regression.

result.summary: Design doc written. New component EntityListBrowserPage.tsx chosen (prevents BilimBaga regression). FilterClause/SortClause shapes confirmed from api.ts (dir field, not direction). Route: /entities/:entityType. FilterBar with queried-only fields. Sort via two dropdowns, columns non-sortable. Page-size select (25/50/100/250). field_not_allowed -> inline banner; page_size_too_large -> inline under control.
